stemMode.label: Stem Separation Mode
stemMode.description: Controls how new songs are separated. Four-stem is the default — the model outputs four stems natively at the same processing time. Existing separations are not affected, and songs can be compressed to two stems later to save space.

modelVariant.label: AI Model
modelVariant.description: Choose between faster processing or higher quality separation.
modelVariant.htdemucsFtDescription: May produce artifacts in accompaniment tracks
modelVariant.ftWarningMessage: The fine-tuned model may produce audible noise or artifacts in accompaniment tracks for some songs. Vocal separation quality may be slightly better. Use at your own risk.
modelVariant.legacyOnDisk: Old version on disk — delete in Danger Zone, then download again

runtime.label: ONNX Runtime
runtime.description: The runtime library that powers AI stem separation.
runtime.installRequired: The ONNX Runtime library is required for AI stem separation. Install it to enable model downloads.
runtime.corrupt: The installed ONNX Runtime is corrupt. Reinstall it to enable model downloads.
runtime.downloadFailed: The ONNX Runtime download failed. Check your connection and try again.
runtime.upToDate: The runtime is up to date.
runtime.candidateReadyRestartRequired: Runtime update {{version}} is staged. Restart to apply it.
runtime.activationFailedPreviousRestored: The staged runtime update failed to activate; the previous runtime was restored.

updatePolicy.label: Runtime updates
updatePolicy.description: Choose how runtime updates are handled. Applying an update always requires a restart.
updatePolicy.manualDescription: Only check for updates when you ask.
updatePolicy.notifyDescription: Check on startup and let you know when an update is available.
updatePolicy.autoDownloadDescription: Download updates automatically; apply them on the next restart.

banner.updateReady: A runtime update is ready — restart to apply.
banner.activationFailed: The runtime update failed to activate; the previous runtime was restored.
banner.runtimeRequired: ONNX Runtime required for AI stem separation.
banner.runtimeRequiredHint: It downloads automatically the first time you separate a song.
banner.downloadFailedHint: Check your connection, then retry the download.

hideBatchSeparate.description: Hide the sidebar button that separates all songs.

coverArtBackdrop.description: Removes the blurred album cover behind lyrics.

appearance.label: Appearance
appearance.description: Choose the application color scheme. The audience stage stays dark.

eq.label: Equalizer
eq.description: 5-band equalizer with automatic preamp and soft limiter.

crossfade.label: Crossfade
crossfade.description: Overlap the end of one track with the start of the next using an equal-power curve.

dangerZone.label: Danger Zone
dangerZone.deleteStemsDescription: Remove all cached stem files to free disk space
dangerZone.deleteLyricsDescription: Remove all fetched and cached lyrics. Lyrics will be re-fetched when songs are played.
dangerZone.downgradeStemsDescription: Remove drums, bass, and other stems from all 4-stem songs. Vocals and accompaniment are preserved.
dangerZone.deleteModelDescription: Remove the downloaded model file to free disk space. It will need to be re-downloaded if you select this model again.
dangerZone.deleteActiveModelBlockedTitle: Switch models before deleting this file
dangerZone.deleteLegacyActiveModelTitle: Delete outdated file to allow upgrade download
dangerZone.confirmDeleteModel: Are you sure you want to delete this model? You will need to re-download it to use it again.
dangerZone.deleteRuntimeDescription: Remove the ONNX Runtime library to free disk space. It will be re-downloaded when you start a separation.

confirmDeleteStems.title: Delete All Separated Stems
confirmDeleteStems.message: This will permanently delete all cached stem files. Songs will need to be re-separated to use karaoke mode.

confirmDowngradeStems.title: Downgrade All Songs to 2-Stem
confirmDowngradeStems.message: This will remove the individual drums, bass, and other stems from all 4-stem songs. An accompaniment track will be created by mixing them. This cannot be undone.

confirmDeleteLyrics.title: Delete All Cached Lyrics
confirmDeleteLyrics.message: This will permanently delete all cached lyrics. Lyrics will be automatically re-fetched when songs are played.

confirmDeleteRuntime.title: Delete ONNX Runtime
confirmDeleteRuntime.message: This will delete the ONNX Runtime library. It will be automatically re-downloaded the next time you start a separation.

executionProvider.xnnpackDescription: SIMD-accelerated CPU — faster on Apple Silicon and modern x86
